name: Bright Dairy & Food Co.,Ltd
summary: Bright Dairy & Food Co.,Ltd (BD&F), a prominent Chinese food enterprise headquartered in Shanghai, manages a comprehensive dairy operation within China. Its activities span the entire dairy value chain, from dairy cow breeding and cultivation to the full-scale development, production, and distribution of a diverse array of products. BD&F's extensive portfolio features fresh milk, various forms of yogurt (including both traditional and shelf-stable options), lactic acid bacteria beverages, specialized milk powders for infants, middle-aged individuals, and seniors, alongside cheese, butter, and a selection of cold desserts. Founded in 1911, the company initially operated as Shanghai Guangming Dairy Co., Ltd. before rebranding to its current name in 2003. Bright Dairy & Food Co.,Ltd functions as a subsidiary of the larger Bright Food (Group) Co., LTD.
